title: nania vera
intro: Nania vera, commonly known as Aerva lanata, is a flowering plant species native to tropical regions of Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Nania vera include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
